passport.title: Security Passport
passport.description: Issued at sign-in and enforced on every query before retrieval — not by the model.
passport.step1: 1. Identity and role are verified before a passport is issued.
passport.step2: 2. Input is scanned for credentials and PII; unsafe material never leaves the gateway.
passport.step3: 3. Authorisation is evaluated before documents are retrieved — not by the model.
passport.step4: 4. Output is guarded again before it reaches your screen.
passport.step5: 5. Every decision is written to an auditable, secret-free security log.

help.title: Help / About
help.description: What TalkHub is, how the zero-trust gateway protects you, and how to use voice and languages.
help.aboutBody: TalkHub is a zero-trust AI gateway for government knowledge. It gives employees source-backed answers from authorised policy documents while keeping security, privacy and human oversight at the centre.
help.howTitle: How the gateway protects every question
help.how1: 1. Your identity, role and clearance are verified and a Security Passport is issued.
help.how2: 2. Your question is scanned for credentials and personal information; unsafe material is blocked or redacted.
help.how3: 3. Authorisation is checked before any document is retrieved.
help.how4: 4. The answer is composed only from authorised, cited sources and guarded again on the way out.
help.how5: 5. High-risk or low-confidence cases are escalated to authorised human officers.
help.voiceBody: Use the microphone button in the assistant to speak your question. Speech is converted to text on your device only — no audio is recorded, stored or sent to any AI system. The recognised text appears in the input box so you can review and edit it before pressing Send. It then passes through the same security gateway as typed text.
help.langBody: TalkHub works in English, Hindi and Gujarati. Use the language selector in the header to switch the entire application; your choice is remembered on this device. Voice recognition follows the selected language (en-IN, hi-IN, gu-IN).
help.securityBody: Passwords, OTPs and access tokens are blocked before they can reach any AI system and are never stored. Audit logs record metadata and reasons only. Employees see simple protection status; detailed risk analytics are restricted to authorised security personnel.
help.supportBody: For access changes, clearance updates or security concerns, contact your department IT desk or security officer. This is a demonstration prototype with fictional data.
